Things to Know

The Fine Print

Each event reservation includes exclusive use of our main gathering and lounge area, with the layout configured to your preference by our team before you arrive. Up to 50 guests. Outside food and non-alcoholic beverages welcome.

Capacity
50 Guests
Main gathering and lounge area. Includes renter, guests, vendors, and support staff. Maximum 50 persons.
Pricing
$150 / hour
3-hour minimum. A separate $150 refundable security deposit holds your date. It covers potential damages and is returned after your event — it does not go toward your rental fee.
Cancellation
14-Day Notice
Cancel 14 or more days before your event for a full refund. Full terms in your rental agreement.
Approved Events
  • Mental health and wellness workshops
  • Healing circles and support groups
  • Spiritual wellness gatherings
  • Community wellness education and training
  • Wellness practitioner development
  • Cultural affirmation and connection events
  • Intimate celebrations aligned with our wellness mission
  • Branding and professional photo shoots *
Not Permitted
  • Baby showers, gender reveals, or children-focused events
  • Alcohol-centered or general social events
  • Commercial, political, or non-wellness gatherings

* Branding and photo shoots are available at a flat rate of $150 for a 2-hour block during designated open hours only. Standard hourly rental rate does not apply.

What's Included
  • Exclusive use of the gathering and lounge area
  • Layout set to your preference before arrival
  • Curated furniture, decor, and ambiance
  • Restroom and common area access
  • Outside food and non-alcoholic beverages welcome
Please Note
  • Alcohol is strictly prohibited
  • Furniture may not be moved by renters or guests
  • All materials must be cleared by departure time
